data: Is the blue line, representing Feudal-DQN, always higher than the red dotted line, representing GP-Sarsa, in the right graph labeled "Laptops" after 2000 training dialogues?

The blue line, representing Feudal-DQN, is not always higher than the red dotted line, representing GP-Sarsa, in the right graph labeled "Laptops" after 2000 training dialogues. There are instances where the red dotted line is above the blue line, indicating that GP-Sarsa performs better than Feudal-DQN at those points. Therefore, the statement is false.
